derivation.scalar: V_A(r,rprime)=exp[-i integral_straight_(rprime->r) A.dl] V_NL(r,rprime), kinetic (p+A)^2 in Ry; A(r)=epsilon*a*exp(i q.r).
derivation.nonlocal: L_NL = integral_0^1 [(a.d_u B(u)) D B(v)^dagger + B(u) D (conj(a).d_v B(v))^dagger] dt; u=pt-tq, v=ps+(1-t)q. Placement exp[-i u.tau] and exp[-i v.tau] retained; atomic derivative phase legs cancel, not the finite-q atomic phase.
derivation.kinetic: Exact integer join Gt=Gs-reciprocal_fold, coefficient (pt+ps).a. No FFT alias, no PW-square map.
derivation.uniform: Exact q=0/same-identity endpoint uses existing PhysicalFieldVertices analytically, complex direction split into real and imaginary components; adjoint conjugates direction.
derivation.quadrature: Explicit finite Gauss-Legendre line order; original exact radial Simpson/UPFRadial and centered_derivatives, not interpolated A25 beta or an additional correction.

oracle.independent_layer: Literal real-space spherical/radial UPF amplitudes, dense two-point scalar with analytic straight-line exp(iq.midpoint)*sinc(q.separation/2) kernel. boundable_work_storage.symbols: Ns,Nt endpoint rows; C input columns; R_l retained radial nodes; h_l species projector channels; A_l species atoms; B bounded column block; A bounded atom block; Q line order.
boundable_work_storage.persistent: Borrowed input background and existing physical endpoint factors remain resident; returned output is O(Nout*C). Exact kinetic join O(Ns+Nt) entries, no square matrix.
boundable_work_storage.temporary: At one line node/species: endpoint centered values/directional derivatives O((Ns+Nt)*h_l); placed banks O(2*(Ns+Nt)*A*h_l) complex values; overlap/products O(A*h_l*B+(Ns+Nt)*B). UPFRadial row workspace bounds row dimension at256. Species, line nodes, atom blocks and columns streamed.
boundable_work_storage.leading_work: Radial construction O(Q*sum_l((Ns+Nt)*R_l*nbeta_l)), plus low-rank two-leg forward/adjoint multiplies O(Q*sum_l((Ns+Nt)*A_l*h_l*C)); no dense PW operator. Each apply/adjoint call recomputes line projectors intentionally rather than caching Q banks.
boundable_work_storage.oracle: Small dense oracle only: realspace14x28 angular points x5 radial nodes, 64 realspace-row blocks; one atom kernel block64x1960, small PW dense matrices. Not a material surrogate.
